stories.title: Nvidia, Broadcom shielded as AI power crunch hits chip supply chain, says Morgan Stanley
stories.summary: Power availability is emerging as a constraint on AI infrastructure deployment, with knock-on effects for parts of the semiconductor supply chain.
stories.why: AI demand is no longer constrained only by chips. Power, memory, networking and data-centre infrastructure can determine how quickly accelerator demand turns into deployed compute.

stories.title: Applied Materials and Besi expand partnership for next-generation AI packaging
stories.summary: The partnership expands work across hybrid bonding, thermo-compression bonding and die-on-panel integration.
stories.why: AI systems increasingly depend on tightly integrating logic, HBM and other chiplets. Better bonding and interconnect density can improve bandwidth and power efficiency while enabling larger 3D packages.

stories.title: Applied Materials and KIOXIA partner to advance next-generation memory technology
stories.summary: A new collaboration at Applied's EPIC Center focuses on next-generation memory process innovation.
stories.why: AI growth is pulling memory technology forward alongside logic. Equipment/process co-development can shorten the path from new memory structures to high-volume manufacturing.

stories.title: Scaling next-generation 3D NAND with high-precision selective removal
stories.summary: Applied describes selective-removal process technology aimed at increasingly complex 3D NAND structures.
stories.why: As NAND stacks become taller and more complex, process selectivity and profile control become harder. New removal techniques can help preserve critical structures while enabling further vertical scaling.

stories.title: Why panel-level processing could transform advanced semiconductor packaging
stories.summary: Lam examines the shift from wafer-based packaging toward larger panel formats for AI-era packages.
stories.why: Panels offer more usable area for very large multi-chip packages and may lower cost per package, but they introduce difficult uniformity, handling and process-control problems — creating new equipment opportunities.

stories.title: Lam's global lab network compresses the path from discovery to fab deployment
stories.summary: Lam describes its globally integrated R&D infrastructure and how it connects process development with customer fabs.
stories.why: Semiconductor process changes are expensive and slow to qualify. Closer collaboration between equipment labs and fabs can reduce development cycles at major technology inflection points.

stories.title: SABRE 3D: powering the next era of advanced packaging
stories.summary: Lam highlights electrochemical deposition for precision copper plating in advanced 3D packages.
stories.why: Dense vertical interconnects require highly controlled copper deposition. Packaging is becoming a front-line scaling technology as AI chips grow beyond what a single reticle-sized die can economically provide.

stories.title: Advanced packaging for AI: the future of semiconductor scaling
stories.summary: Lam explains why packaging has become central to scaling AI compute, memory bandwidth and energy efficiency.
stories.why: Traditional transistor scaling alone cannot deliver all the performance AI systems need. Chiplets, HBM and advanced interconnects increasingly determine system-level performance and power.
